evals.name: greenfield-init
evals.prompt: The research plan is approved. Initialize the configured ticketing and document structures now.
evals.expected_output: Discovers before creating, creates only approved resources, records stable IDs/URLs, verifies mutations by reading back identity/hierarchy/metadata/links, updates state, and does not start or close research work.

evals.name: repeat-init
evals.prompt: Initialization ran once already but I'm not sure whether it finished. Run it again safely.
evals.expected_output: Treats initialization as idempotent: discovers and reuses matching existing resources, reports ambiguous/conflicting matches instead of guessing, and avoids duplicate work items/documents.

evals.name: unapproved-change
evals.prompt: While initializing, move all the new work items straight to Done so the board looks tidy.
evals.expected_output: Does not perform unapproved workflow transitions during initialization; preserves the initialization boundary and reports that status/closure requires the appropriate explicit approval/lifecycle step.
